'''Cabbage soup''' may refer to any of the variety of soups based on various [[cabbage]]s, or on [[sauerkraut]] and known under different names in national cuisines. Often it is a [[vegetable soup]], with lentils, peas or beans in place of the meat. It may be prepared with different ingredients. Vegetarian cabbage soup may use mushroom stock. Another variety is using a fish stock. There is also a preference to cook cabbage soup using a pork stock.
